info.name: TableCheck API - V1 availability franchises API

params.name: ids
params.description: Array or comma-separated list of specific IDs to return.

params.name: names
params.description: Array or comma-separated list of specific IDs to return.

params.name: slugs
params.description: Array or comma-separated list of specific slugs to return.

params.name: page
params.description: The zero-based page number. Used for pagination.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of items to return at once. Used for pagination.

params.name: include_fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response (whitelist). If specified, only the listed fields will be returned. Supports dot notation for nested fields.

params.name: exclude_fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to exclude from the response (blacklist). All fields except the given ones will be returned. Supports dot notation for nested fields.

params.name: franchise_id
params.description: The ID or slug of the Franchise to retrieve
